dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 05, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Mets Stun Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**

The New York Mets took down the Atlanta Braves 10-9 in a wild game that saw Drake Baldwin lead the charge with two hits, one home run, and four RBIs. Baldwin's explosive performance was matched by Juan Soto, who contributed two hits and an RBI for the Mets. On the mound, Nolan McLean earned the win with 6.0 innings of work, striking out five and allowing just two earned runs. The Braves' Michael Harris II had a key hit, singling in a run to keep his team in the game late.

**Pirates Cruise to 11-5 Win Over Nationals**

The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Washington Nationals 11-5, with Brandon Lowe leading the way with a home run and three RBIs. Lowe's power was matched by Bryan Reynolds, who contributed two hits and an RBI for the Pirates. The Nationals' Keibert Ruiz had two hits, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Pirates' strong offense. On the mound, Gregory Soto earned the win with 5.0 innings of work, allowing just one earned run.

**Reds Edge Orioles in Low-Scoring Affair**

The Cincinnati Reds edged the Baltimore Orioles 2-3 in a low-scoring game that saw Spencer Steer hit a home run and drive in two runs for the Reds. Steer's power was matched by Taylor Ward, who contributed two hits and an RBI for the Orioles. On the mound, Nick Lodolo earned the win with 6.0 innings of work, striking out four and allowing just one earned run.

**Twins Shut Down Yankees 6-1**

The Minnesota Twins shut down the New York Yankees 6-1, with Joe Ryan leading the way on the mound. Ryan threw 7.0 innings, striking out nine and allowing no earned runs. At the plate, Royce Lewis had two hits and drove in two runs for the Twins. The Yankees' Jasson Domínguez went 0-for-3 with a double play.

**White Sox Edge Guardians in Back-and-Forth Affair**

The Chicago White Sox edged the Cleveland Guardians 7-6 in a back-and-forth game that saw Gabriel Arias hit a home run and drive in three runs for the Guardians. Arias' power was matched by Jordan Walker, who contributed a home run and four RBIs for the White Sox. On the mound, Erick Fedde earned the win with 5.0 innings of work, allowing just two earned runs.

**Cubs Outlast Cardinals 4-6**

The Chicago Cubs outlasted the St. Louis Cardinals 4-6 in a wild game that saw Jordan Walker hit a home run and drive in four runs for the Cardinals. Walker's power was matched by JJ Wetherholt, who contributed a home run and an RBI for the Cubs. On the mound, Drew Pomeranz earned the win with 5.0 innings of work, allowing just two earned runs.

**Royals Shut Down Phillies 5-2**

The Kansas City Royals shut down the Philadelphia Phillies 5-2, with Aaron Nola leading the way on the mound. Nola threw 7.0 innings, striking out seven and allowing three earned runs. At the plate, Salvador Perez had two hits and drove in two runs for the Royals. The Phillies' Bryson Stott had two hits, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Royals' strong pitching.

**Astros Shut Down Rays 2-0**

The Houston Astros shut down the Tampa Bay Rays 2-0, with Mason Englert leading the way on the mound. Englert threw 5.2 innings, striking out nine and allowing two earned runs. At the plate, Isaac Paredes had two hits and drove in a run for the Rays. Paredes' power was matched by Christian Walker, who contributed a home run and an RBI for the Rays.

**Tigers Edge Rangers 6-3**

The Detroit Tigers edged the Texas Rangers 6-3, with Riley Greene leading the way at the plate. Greene had three hits, including a home run, and drove in four runs for the Tigers. On the mound, Casey Mize earned the win with 5.0 innings of work, allowing just two earned runs.

**Rockies Outlast Giants 7-6**

The Colorado Rockies outlasted the San Francisco Giants 7-6 in a wild game that saw Rafael Devers hit two home runs and drive in two runs for the Rockies. Devers' power was matched by Kyle Karros, who contributed a home run and an RBI for the Giants. On the mound, Victor Vodnik earned the win with 5.0 innings of work, allowing just two earned runs.

**Brewers Edge Diamondbacks 3-2**

The Milwaukee Brewers edged the Arizona Diamondbacks 3-2, with Jake Bauers leading the way at the plate. Bauers had a home run and drove in two runs for the Brewers. On the mound, Drew Rom earned the win with 5.0 innings of work, allowing just two earned runs.

**Marlins Edge Athletics 9-8**

The Miami Marlins edged the Oakland Athletics 9-8 in a wild game that saw Heriberto Hernández hit two home runs and drive in two runs for the Marlins. Hernández's power was matched by Jonah Heim, who contributed a home run and an RBI for the Athletics. On the mound, Eury Pérez earned the win with 7.0 innings of work, striking out eight and allowing no earned runs.

**Mariners Shut Down Blue Jays 4-0**

The Seattle Mariners shut down the Toronto Blue Jays 4-0, with Emerson Hancock leading the way on the mound. Hancock threw 7.0 innings, striking out five and allowing no earned runs. At the plate, Mitch Garver had a home run and drove in two runs for the Mariners.

**Padres Shut Down Dodgers 5-2**

The San Diego Padres shut down the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-2, with JP Sears leading the way on the mound. Sears threw 5.0 innings, striking out five and allowing no earned runs. At the plate, Manny Machado had a home run and drove in three runs for the Padres.

**Red Sox Outlast Angels 7-5**

The Boston Red Sox outlasted the Los Angeles Angels 7-5, with Zach Neto leading the way at the plate. Neto had three hits, including a home run, and drove in two runs for the Red Sox. On the mound, Greg Weissert earned the win with 2.0 innings of work, allowing just one earned run.
